title: VTC — shared join-request definitions
description: Shared types for the vtc/join-requests/* spec family. JoinRequest is the community's view of one pending or decided application to join.

JoinRequest.title: JoinRequest
JoinRequest.description: One application to join a Verifiable Trust Community.

id.description: Stable id of this join request (a UUID).

vp.description: The W3C Verifiable Presentation the applicant submitted (opaque here).

vpClaims.description: Canonical projection of `vp`, extracted when the request was submitted and used as the input the community's join policy reads. Carried on the row so an approval does not have to re-extract it, and opaque here: its members are whatever the community's policy asks of an applicant. `null` on a request recorded before a community began extracting one.

policyDecision.description: The community policy verdict recorded for this request (opaque here); absent while pending.

decision.description:
Why this request was refused, in terms meant for the applicant rather than the operator. `null` unless the request was rejected.

Distinct from `policyDecision`, which records the community's internal verdict: both rejection paths — a policy auto-deny at submit and an admin's later refusal — write this one, so a client reads a single shape instead of reconciling two.

code.description: Stable refusal code, safe to branch on.

reason.description: Elaboration in prose, when the decider gave one.

decidedAt.description: When the decision was taken — not when the poll answering it was produced. On an admin refusal the two diverge by however long the applicant takes to ask.

registryConsent.description: Whether the applicant consented to trust-registry publication.
